name: PositionManager
rootCause: deposit values the vault's existing USDT at the manipulable PancakeSwap V3 spot price, so crashing the spot before depositing mints inflated shares that withdraw redeems in the same transaction. Lost: 32,080.604282 USDT (exactly reproduced) on BNB Chain; one atomic tx crashed the USDT/BTCB spot with an 8,000,000 USDT swap, then ran 24 deposit(1,000,000 USDT)/withdraw cycles to drain the vault's own PancakeSwap V3 position, the pool losing 32,096.098596 USDT
